claims.claim: Lately used (implies light/recent use, good condition)
claims.evidence: No usage history, odometer, or wear indicators visible in photos.

claims.claim: Okay buy and drive to any location
claims.evidence: No video or sound of engine running; static photos only, cannot confirm rideability.

claims.claim: With battery everything (battery and electricals working)
claims.evidence: Battery not visible in any photo; no indicator light or ignition shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run smoothly
risks.proof: Video clip of engine starting and idling/revving

risks.risk: Registration/particulars may be invalid or expired
Battery may be weak or dead despite claim
risks.proof: Photo/video of battery with dashboard lights or ignition on

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn beyond safe use
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear tyre tread

risks.risk: Brakes, gear, or clutch may be faulty
risks.proof: Video of test ride showing braking and gear shifting

risks.risk: Toolkit or spare parts may be missing
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, no toolkit included

risks.risk: Ownership documents may be missing or unverifiable
risks.proof: Photo of proof of purchase or ownership transfer papers
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified ownership, added risk

proof_requests: Video of engine starting, idling, and revving
Photo/video showing battery and electrical system (lights, horn, indicators) working
Close-up photos of tyre tread front and rear
Short test-ride video showing brakes and gear shifting
Photo of toolkit and any spare parts
Photo of ownership/proof of purchase documents
response.reason: The motorcycle's identity (MUONE AX100) is clearly established by the witness, so it can be priced at worst case given multiple unverified mechanical and documentation claims.
